findings: The proof of Prop. 7 (l.1264–1321) does not need Prop. 6 (refuted as printed, OQ-162 (c)) nor any convexity of the contact set F: the formalization uses neither. Prop. 7 is true as printed.
The hypothesis « non vides » (l.1258) is redundant: V ≠ W with V ⊆ W and a common support forces V ≠ ∅.

The proof's finite-dimensional step with interiors (l.1268–1286) can be replaced by Hahn–Banach in finite-dimensional slices spanned by points of V plus dimension-free arguments; the formalized proof does this, and also proves the proof's side claims H = support of F and H ∩ W = F (exists_separe_fort).
questions: « hyperplan » (l.1261): read as a hyperplane of the support L (H = L ∩ {f = c}, f linear, not constant on L), as the proof says at l.1275–1276 (« H ne peut être tout l'espace L … donc H est un hyperplan »). Under the reading « hyperplane of the ambient space » uniqueness fails when L ≠ E: separeHyperplan_ambiant_deux (two hyperplanes of ℝ³).

« séparant » (l.1261): read as weak separation (V and U in opposite closed half-spaces), as l.1266 implies (« on doit avoir F ⊂ H », F ⊆ V). Existence is also proved with U in the open half-space, and uniqueness among weak separators, so every reading in between holds. The reading with V in an open half-space makes the statement false (inter_nonempty_of_separeHyperplan: every separator meets V).

« V fermé » in « L muni de la topologie l.c. la plus fine »: the topology of the affine variety L read as finestLC of its direction carried by an origin P ∈ L (as in facette_isOpen); the ambient reading (closed in finestLC E) is hyperplan_separant_finestLC. Both are proved.
l.1317 « C n'appartient donc pas » read « B » (OQ-160 (a)); the statement is unaffected and the formalized proof does not depend on it.

instances: Benzecri.hyperplan_separant_rectangleBas: V = [0,1]×[0,1/2], W = [0,1]² in ℝ×ℝ satisfy every hypothesis (V closed for finestLC (ℝ×ℝ) via finestLC_prod), and the unique separating hyperplane is the line y = 1/2 (separeHyperplan_rectangleBas).
kb_proposals: Chapter3/HyperplanSeparant: Hahn–Banach on a finite-dimensional slice P = affineSpan T of a bare vector space: carry P to Fin n → ℝ by y ↦ (D.subtype ∘ (finBasis D).equivFun.symm) y + O (an AffineMap built with ⟨toFun, linear, map_vadd'⟩), separate there with geometric_hahn_banach_of_nonempty_interior (interior from Convex.interior_nonempty_iff_affineSpan_eq_top), pull the form back with LinearMap.exists_extend (exists_separe_finset).

Chapter3/HyperplanSeparant: from a codimension-one affine subspace S of L to a linear form: Submodule.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem (hx : u₀ - p₁ ∉ S.direction) inferInstance, normalised by its value at u₀ - p₁; points of L decompose by AffineSubspace.mem_affineSpan_insert_iff.
A point of affineSpan S is in the affineSpan of a Finset ⊆ S: eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_image (p := id) then affineCombination_mem_affineSpan_image (exists_finset_of_mem_affineSpan).

Uniqueness of a separating hyperplane of V and W − V needs no interiors in any dimension: every separator contains the contact set F, and L = affineSpan (F ∪ {u₀}) for any u₀ ∈ W − V (mem_affineSpan_insert_pointsContact).
